window: Jun. 29, Aug. 31, Sep. 30 and Oct. 19 – Nov. 5, 2026
summary: Six criminal cases were filed at the Fairbanks court on Thursday. In two of them the district attorney filed no charging document at all and the case was opened and closed the same day — one of those two was an early-morning drunk-driving arrest reported by troopers, on which no driving-under-the-influence charge now exists. A Fairbanks grand jury indicted on a vehicle theft case and jurisdiction moved to the Superior Court. Troopers reported two Interior items for Thursday: that drunk-driving arrest off Cheyenne Court in Fairbanks, and a criminal trespass report at a North Pole roadhouse on which charges were forwarded to the district attorney. Fairbanks Police reported no new arrest for Thursday. Six of the eight Interior cases carrying a hearing on Thursday now record a result, and a jury trial at the Delta Junction courthouse continues on Friday morning. An armed robbery case from October has closed on a misdemeanor conviction entered Oct. 30 after the charge was amended. The court's weekly criminal filings report covers Oct. 29 to Nov. 4 and lists 38 cases filed at Fairbanks, four at Nenana, two at Delta Junction and none at Healy; those are the report's own counts for its own window, which closed before Thursday, so none of Thursday's six Fairbanks cases appears in it. The court's weekly report of cases disposed has not been updated since Nov. 2, so no court outcome later than that date can be reported from it.

entries.title: DUI arrest: Dawn Armbruster
body: Dawn Armbruster, 49, was arrested on a charge of driving under the influence — operating a vehicle while impaired.

Off Cheyenne Court, Fairbanks, Nov. 5 at about 1:57 a.m.; Alaska State Troopers. Troopers say they responded to a report of a disturbance and a possible impaired driver, that the investigation led to her arrest, and that she was taken to the Fairbanks Correctional Center.

Court case 4FA-26-02231CR was opened at Fairbanks on Nov. 5 and closed the same day because no charging document was filed. No driving-under-the-influence charge stands on the court record, and an arraignment set for Nov. 10 was vacated.
Alaska State Troopers, case AK26109450.

sources.label: Alaska State Troopers daily dispatch, Nov. 5

entries.title: Criminal trespass reported at a North Pole roadhouse
body: Troopers say that on Nov. 5 they responded to a disturbance at the 12 Mile Roadhouse in North Pole, where a person who had been asked to leave kept coming in and out of the building, and that charges of criminal trespass in the second degree — entering or remaining unlawfully on premises — were forwarded to the district attorney's office for review.
The dispatch names no one and records no arrest. No court case has been opened on this report.
Alaska State Troopers, case AK26109449.

sources.label: Alaska State Troopers daily dispatch, Nov. 5

entries.title: Vehicle theft indictment: Pearl Gould
body: Pearl Gould is charged with vehicle theft in the first degree — taking someone else's vehicle, aircraft or watercraft — a Class C felony, punishable by up to five years. The offense is recorded as Oct. 19 at Fairbanks.
A Fairbanks grand jury returned an indictment on Nov. 5 and jurisdiction was transferred to the Superior Court the same day.
Case 4FA-26-02123CR; arraignment in the Superior Court Nov. 25, omnibus hearing Dec. 10 and trial week Dec. 28. She is charged, not convicted.

entries.title: Protective order violation charges: Jerome Benjamin Semaken
body: Jerome Benjamin Semaken, 42, is charged with two counts of violating a domestic violence protective order — doing something a protective order forbids — each a Class A misdemeanor. Both counts are recorded by the court as domestic violence related.
2500 block of Mercier Street, Fairbanks, Nov. 4 at 2:29 p.m.; Fairbanks Police.

Fairbanks Police, case 26003367. Court case 4FA-26-02233CR, filed Nov. 5; he was arraigned the same afternoon and release conditions were entered. Pre-trial conference Dec. 24; trial week Jan. 4, 2027. He is charged, not convicted.

entries.title: Theft and release violation charges: Dustin Gregory Harrison
body: Dustin Gregory Harrison is charged with theft in the third degree — taking property worth $250 to $749 — and with violating a condition of release on a felony charge, both Class A misdemeanors. The offenses are recorded as Nov. 4 at Fairbanks.

Case 4FA-26-02232CR, filed Nov. 5; he was arraigned the same afternoon and the public defender agency was appointed. Pre-trial conference Jan. 7, 2027; trial week Jan. 19, 2027. He is charged, not convicted.

entries.title: Drug and weapons charges: Dustin Gregory Harrison
body: Dustin Gregory Harrison is charged with misconduct involving a controlled substance in the fifth degree — possessing a controlled substance — and misconduct involving weapons in the fourth degree — possessing or selling metal knuckles — both Class A misdemeanors. The offenses are recorded as Sep. 30 at Fairbanks.
Case 4FA-26-02234CR, filed Nov. 5; he was arraigned the same afternoon. Pre-trial conference Dec. 24; trial week Jan. 4, 2027. He is charged, not convicted.

entries.title: Assault charges: Kevin R Walker
body: Kevin R Walker is charged with two counts of assault in the fourth degree — recklessly injuring someone — each a Class A misdemeanor. Both counts are recorded by the court as domestic violence related. The offenses are recorded as Aug. 31 at North Pole.
Case 4FA-26-02122CR, filed Oct. 17 on a summons. An indictment or information was filed in open court on Nov. 5. No hearing is set. He is charged, not convicted.

entries.title: Instruction permit charge: Mason James Sweetsir
body: Mason James Sweetsir is charged with driving in violation of an instruction permit — driving without the supervision a learner's permit requires — a misdemeanor the court records as not classified. The offense is recorded as Nov. 1 at Fairbanks.
Case 4FA-26-02235CR, filed Nov. 5 on a citation; arraignment Dec. 4. He is charged, not convicted.

entries.title: Disorderly conduct arrest: Jenell M. Semaken
body: Jenell M. Semaken, 43, was arrested on a charge of disorderly conduct, recorded by police as creating a hazardous condition and as a misdemeanor.
2200 block of South Cushman Street, Fairbanks, Nov. 5 at 1:55 a.m.; Fairbanks Police.
Court case 4FA-26-02230CR was opened at Fairbanks on Nov. 5 and closed the same day because no charging document was filed. No charge stands on the court record.
Fairbanks Police, case 26003375.

entries.title: Armed robbery case ends in misdemeanor conviction: Daniel Zachary Schwietert
body: The case against Daniel Zachary Schwietert, 25, charged in October with robbery in the first degree over an incident at a Fairbanks sporting goods store, has closed. The robbery charge was amended on Oct. 16 to attempted theft in the third degree — attempting to take property worth $250 to $749 — a Class B misdemeanor.

The court record shows a guilty plea and a conviction entered on that amended charge on Oct. 30, with a judgment the same day and surcharges of $150 due Nov. 10. The case was recorded as closed and the remaining hearings, including a pre-trial conference on Nov. 5 and a trial week of Nov. 16, were vacated.
Case 4FA-26-02078CR. Troopers said earlier they were called to Beaver Sports in Fairbanks at 1:46 p.m. on Oct. 12 for a reported robbery and arrested him.

entries.title: Six of eight Interior cases with a Thursday hearing record a result; Delta Junction jury trial continues Friday
body: Six of the eight open Interior criminal cases that carried a hearing on Thursday, Nov. 5 now record a result. Preliminary hearings were held in 4FA-26-02117CR and 4FA-26-02098CR, and both cases are now set for arraignment in the Superior Court on Nov. 18. A pre-trial conference in 4FA-26-01852CR was continued to Jan. 7, 2027. Two bail hearing entries in 4FA-26-01826CR record one hearing continued and one held. Omnibus hearings of the Superior Court in 4FA-26-01896CR and 4DJ-26-00060CR were both continued, with the next set for Jan. 28, 2027.

A jury trial in a 2024 Delta Junction case, 4DJ-24-00006CR, sat at the Delta Junction courthouse on Thursday morning and continues there on Friday, Nov. 6, at 9:15 a.m. A Fairbanks omnibus hearing in the same case was vacated, as was a pre-trial conference in 4FA-26-02078CR, which has closed.
Nineteen open Interior criminal cases record activity dated Nov. 5. No new criminal case was filed at Nenana, Healy or Delta Junction during the day.

entries.title: Domestic violence assault arrest: Aaliyah Koenig
body: Aaliyah Koenig was arrested on a charge of domestic violence assault — assaulting a household member.

Delta Junction, June 29; Alaska State Troopers. Troopers say they received a report of a domestic violence assault after the fact, that the investigation determined she injured a household member, and that she was arrested and remanded at the Fairbanks Correctional Center, held without bail.
Alaska State Troopers, case AK26061734. Court case 4DJ-26-00068CR at Delta Junction.

entries.title: Criminal trespass summons: Rachel Hancock
body: Rachel Hancock, 26, of Healy was issued a summons on a charge of criminal trespass in the second degree — entering or remaining unlawfully on premises — recorded by troopers as a misdemeanor.

A Healy gas station, Oct. 30 at 9:39 p.m.; Alaska State Troopers. Troopers say they received a report of trespassing at the gas station that evening and identified her as the suspect, that they could not locate her that day, and that they contacted her on Nov. 4 and issued the summons.
Alaska State Troopers, case AK26107313. No court case has been opened on this charge.
